# Table

Display data across columns and rows.
See [Data Table guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/data-table/design/)

### When to use

The `Table` component is designed for basic and static **HTML tables** and **does not include interactivity**.

For interactive tables (with sorting, filtering, etc.) or large data sets, use the <LinkTo kind="Components/DataTable" story="basic">Data Table</LinkTo> component.

<Source code="import { Table } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Primary />

<Controls />
